The binary search keeps 0 <= lo <= hi <= o_custkey_n and loads o_custkey_ptr + mid only under mid < o_custkey_n and o_custkey_ptr + lo only under lo < o_custkey_n, whatever the order of the keys. The atomic adds are at the constants 0..6 of out_numcust_ptr and out_totacctbal_ptr, inside their 7 elements.
